quarterly_data.signal: In the EVX-01 melanoma Phase 2 program, 86% of vaccine-selected targets generated an immune response and 86% of immunogenic targets generated a de novo T-cell response. Previously reported two-year data showed a 75% objective response rate, 25% complete response rate and 92% of responders still responding.
quarterly_data.figure: 86% immune response; 86% de novo T-cell response; 75% ORR; 25% CR

quarterly_data.signal: The EVX-05 glioblastoma program used AI-Immunology to mine approximately 1.5 million endogenous retroviral fragments and select 16 targets. EVX-04 comprises 16 targets, with a regulatory filing planned by year end.
quarterly_data.figure: ~1.5M fragments screened; 16 EVX-05 targets; 16 EVX-04 targets

quarterly_data.signal: Second-quarter net loss was $3.7 million and cash was $14 million. Management said the cash position supported runway into the second half of 2027, with three-year EVX-01 data planned for ESMO in October.
